item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
What's new

  • Calendar: dragging events is rebuilt. The dragged event stays fixed while a clean preview follows the pointer; scrolling pauses during the drag, and resizing the top or bottom edge is smooth and predictable.
  • Calendar: moving events across days, 15-minute snapping and read-only calendar behaviour all remain intact.
  • Documentation: the repository now contains a complete guide set (features, menus and shortcuts, development, testing, data model, integrations, troubleshooting, limitations, releases).
  • Updates: Sparkle’s sandboxed installer configuration is included, so automatic updates work from this build onward.
